Pick one read and justify it, or explicitly frame it as a genuine toss-up rather than asserting failure in one section and hedging in another. And price was fast.' and 01:04 'They're all mine.' read as customer answers mislabeled as 'rep') — Stage 3's pacing/rep-behavior analysis rests on trusting these labels and should note the transcription unreliability rather than treating every 'rep:' line at face value.
